native: EXP156B fold-local eth V2/F16 seed1, all original parameters/buffers frozen, native K20 and original logit argmax
preprocessing_eligibility_caveat: Original get_valid_id requires minimum future existence. Existing valid-count/neighbor eligibility are retained, not rebuilt using futures by this study; no future coordinates enter forward. This selection bias prevents interpreting performance as strictly deployment-available information without a separate past-only eligibility audit.

pre_outcome_amendment.reason: Processed arrays omit pedestrian identity and contain negative/aliased frame identifiers. Restore full-window source metadata before claiming independence. Merge multiple recordings of the same physical scene family conservatively.
pre_outcome_amendment.OOF: Leave-one-verified-scene-family-out within original FIT; this purges every same-scene track/time window across folds. Unverified rows excluded only from OOF and listed.
pre_outcome_amendment.too_few_clusters: Three scene families insufficient for well-powered group bootstrap or exchangeability-backed permutation inference. Report no reliable CI/Holm p values, exploratory contrasts only.
pre_outcome_amendment.CAL: Original CAL unchanged, descriptive evaluation; not an independent group split. No hyperparameter choice.
pre_outcome_amendment.native_training_history: Frozen F16 already trained on original data; probe grouped holdout does not retroactively create independent native validation.

probe_features: R2:R1 plus actual valid relative-neighbor histories and distance/closing/TCA/DCA

probes.primary: L2 logistic C=.1,1,10, choose nested FIT scene-group heldout logloss, fixed C1 if inner groups insufficient
probes.standardization: Training partition only for each inner/outer fold
probes.capacity_sensitivity: Both full dimension and train-only PCA<=64
probes.type_onset_direction: Secondary C1 logistic on R2/E2_motion/E3, actual-event subset; conditional accuracy not deployable full event-and-timing prediction
probes.null_sanity: Destroy training label association by within-scene shuffle; not formal group permutation p value
probes.resume: Per-job SHA verified completed-job skipping; unfinished MLP epoch checkpoint parameter/optimizer/allRNG/history restoration tested by two real FIT epochs

functional_diagnosis.support_caveat: Small perturbation magnitude is not proof of support membership or beneficial use

human_blind_materials.interface: Data-only past-first/reveal package; existing visualization remains immutable; a new blind UI can be added later

progress_queries: One halfway-time query after real verified independent start; then one revised completion deadline check, quiet while unchanged
